## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--wilson.md)

Wilson and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are academic rivals who compete against one another for the medal at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They study alongside each other and their fellow classmates as they maintain a dedicated focus on their studies ahead of the academy examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), +1 more_

- Rival of — competitors for the medal at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--wilson.md)

Wilson and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are rivals competing for the prestigious medal offered at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Both prepare alongside their peers for the upcoming examinations as the academic term nears its conclusion.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), +1 more_

### [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/norman-douglas--wilson.md)

Wilson works as the housekeeper for [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md). The employment places Wilson directly in Douglas's household during his interactions with the local [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary residents.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P61](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0061)_
